CRLR No.977 of 2024
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Mr. K.K. Harbola, Advocate for the 
revisionist.
 Mr. Virendra Singh Rawat, AGA for 
the State/respondent no.1.
 The challenge in this revision is made 
to the order dated 21.11.2024, passed by 
the court of Judge, Family Court/Sessions 
Judge, District Champawat in Misc. 
Criminal Case No.09 of 2024, Divya 
Chaudhary vs. Naveen Singh Mehra, 
under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal 
Procedure, 1973. By it, the revisionist has 
been directed to pay `15,000/- per month 
to the respondent no.2, as maintenance. 
 Heard.
 Admit.
 Issue notice to the respondent no.2, 
returnable within six weeks. Steps to be 
taken within a week.
 Call for the LCR.
 List on 10.03.2025. 
 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 03.01.2025

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
CRLR No.977 of 2024
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. K.K. Harbola, learned counsel for the Revisionist.
2. Mr. Vipul Painuly, learned AGA, for the State of 
Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. Yogesh Pandey, learned counsel for the private 
Respondent.
4. There is an earnest effort made on behalf of the Court 
as well as the learned counsel for the parties whereby parties 
were referred to mediation. On the first count, the parties does 
not reach to the learned Mediator thereby it could not be 
materialized and on the third count i.e. on 07.11.2025 learned 
Mediator has reported that after interacting with the parties, 
the parties could not reach to the amicable settlement at this 
stage, and drew a conclusion that the mediation proceedings 
are closed as unsuccessful. 
5. Since despite efforts the mediation has failed, and there 
seems to be very bleak chance for getting reconciliation 
between the parties.
6. List this matter for final hearing on 23.12.2025.
7. Registry is directed to prepare a paper-book and supply 
to the learned counsel for the parties on the payment of usual 
charges.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 
 18.11.2025
Nitesh/
